about:
Pacific Island Medical Inc was established in 1994 in Kailua, on the windward side of O'ahu. The company is locally owned and operated, with its staff based on the island to serve Hawaii's respiratory equipment needs.

The firm operates as a respiratory home medical equipment vendor, supplying CPAP and BiPAP devices, non-invasive ventilation systems, home oxygen equipment, and related supplies from leading industry brands. Beyond product distribution, it provides personal CPAP set-up and training through three channels: in-office at its Kailua location, home visits anywhere on O'ahu, and remote support for the neighbor islands. Walk-in and will-call service is available during weekday business hours.

The company serves patients across Hawaii who require sleep apnea and respiratory therapy equipment. It works with most Hawaii-based insurance plans, though it does not accept Traditional Medicare Part B (most Advantage plans are accepted), Devoted Health Plans, Kaiser, or VA coverage. Orders are processed once all insurer-required documentation is received.

The business emphasizes knowledgeable, professional, and friendly service delivered by a local team. Its 30-plus years of experience in the islands, combined with personalized support and accessible staff, are cited as the foundation of its position as a premier provider of CPAP and respiratory equipment in Hawaii.
